name: SteamVeil / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A sharp pressurized steam decompression and a broad bright vapor hiss, swelling once and holding before falling into scattered sputtering hot water droplets. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
